title: Much y many
communication_goal: Preguntar y responder sobre cantidades usando much con no contables y many con contables plurales.
situation: Hablas de cuánto trabajo, comida o tiempo hay en una actividad cotidiana.

vocabulary.example: How much time do we have?
I have a lot of homework.
We have a lot of time.

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.english: How much time do we have?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.english: We have a lot of time. The test starts at two.
dialogue.spanish: Tenemos mucho tiempo. El examen empieza a las dos.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.english: There are many questions, but they are easy.
dialogue.spanish: Hay muchas preguntas, pero son fáciles.

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.english: I don't have much money for a new book.
dialogue.spanish: No tengo mucho dinero para un libro nuevo.

explanation_es: Much acompaña sustantivos no contables: much time, much money, much homework. Many acompaña sustantivos contables plurales: many questions, many people. En conversación afirmativa suele sonar más natural a lot of para ambos: a lot of time, a lot of questions.
spanish_speaker_notes: No digas many homework; homework es no contable: much homework o a lot of homework.
People es plural contable: many people.
Much y many son especialmente comunes en preguntas y negaciones.
A lot of funciona con contables plurales y no contables en afirmaciones.

targets.text: How much time do we have?
There are a lot of questions.

pronunciation.tip_es: No acentúes much o many de forma exagerada; la palabra clave suele ser el sustantivo.

reading.title: A busy study day
reading.text: Ben has a lot of homework and many questions to review. He has much less time than Ella, but he has a lot of energy. They have many exercises and enough time to finish them before the test.

activities.instruction: Clasifica cada sustantivo según use much o many.
Escucha: How many questions are there? Elige la respuesta adecuada.
activities.feedback: Many/questions pregunta por una cantidad contable plural.

activities.instruction: Completa: How ___ money do you have?
Ordena: a lot of / have / we / time / .
activities.answer: We have a lot of time.
activities.feedback: A lot of funciona con time, que es no contable.

activities.instruction: Corrige: How many homework do you have?
activities.answer: How much homework do you have?
activities.feedback: Homework es no contable y usa much.

activities.instruction: Pregunta y responde: How much time do we have? We have a lot of time.
activities.target: How much time do we have? We have a lot of time.

activities.instruction: Lee A Busy Study Day y responde: What does Ben have many of?
activities.answer: He has many questions and exercises.

activities.instruction: La IA será tu compañero preparando un examen. Hablen de tiempo, preguntas, tareas, dinero y ejercicios.
activities.ai_language: English; contrast much, many and a lot of naturally

activities.instruction: Describe tu próxima sesión de estudio con seis frases: dos con much, dos con many y dos con a lot of.
success_criteria: a lot of con sustantivos adecuados

must_demonstrate: usar a lot of en afirmaciones
mastery_criteria.retry: Si dudas, mira el sustantivo: ¿es una sustancia/concepto o un plural que puedes contar?
